senses.gloss:
(as opposite to सत्यम्) when falsehood is tole- rated.
1: भा. VIII. १९. ३८-43.
Bali shrinks from it.
2: Ib. VIII. २०. 2-5.
No पातक on five occasions: Jest or fun, speaking to women, for a marriage, when life is in danger, and when deprived of his wealth.
3: M. ३१. १६.
--son of हिम्सा and Adharma; father of Bhaya and Naraka. Br. II. 9. ६३; वा. १०. ३९.
